latest.title: Parabolic-hyperbolic splitting in support propagation for stochastic porous media equations
latest.abstract: We develop a randomly-localized energy method to derive qualitative results on the support propagation of stochastic porous media equations with linear conservative noise. Unlike in previous works, where energies are localized by weighting them with a spatial bump function, we weight them with profiles which are solutions to stochastic transport equations. This modulates out the support propagation due to the conservative noise term, and energy arguments---which otherwise fail in this setting---are again applicable. As a result, finite speed of propagation along with sufficient and necessary conditions on the existence of waiting time phenomena (modulo stochastic transport) are proven. These methods and results demonstrate, on short time scales, that the support propagation may be disintegrated into two independent parts, one due to the evolution of the porous media equation and one due to stochastic transport.
latest.workSummary: 论文用由随机输运方程生成的流映射作为局部化剖面，抵消保守噪声的双曲贡献；随机化能量法由此给出有限传播速度，并分别刻画初值边界平坦或陡峭时的 waiting time 与额外传播。
latest.breakthrough: 把支持传播分解为确定性多孔介质扩散和随机输运两部分，并给出平坦/陡峭初值的充分必要型条件。
latest.limitations: 结论是短时间几何传播，依赖空间有色噪声、非负动理学解和初值边界剖面；长期随机支持形状及更一般噪声未覆盖。

steps.claim: Theorems 2.5、2.7 以随机流坐标给出有限传播和初值平坦时的 waiting time。
steps.route: 将支持外的测试函数沿随机流 $ϕ_t$ 反向运输，使 Stratonovich 输运项与测试函数微分抵消；对 $u^m$ 做局部化能量后，边界平坦度使能量在短时间保持为零，得到传播只由 $ϕ_t$ 搬运。

steps.claim: Lemma 3.2 与 Lemma 4.2 建立随机流和正则化方程的能量恒等式。
steps.route: Lemma 3.2 把 torus 流延拓到欧氏局部坐标并保持微分同胚性；对正则化 sPME 应用 Itô 公式，噪声二次变差与扩散耗散分别显式出现，得到可取极限的局部能量界。

steps.claim: Proposition 5.1 与 Lemma 5.2 给出陡峭初值导致额外支持传播的判别。
steps.route: 把沿流坐标的能量下界写成边界 profile 的积分量 G，Proposition 5.1 将 G 与外部点的非零能量联系；Lemma 5.2 用一维非负函数比较把该能量推进到正时间，从而排除纯输运 waiting time。

steps.claim: Lemmas 6.1–6.2 将随机局部化估计传回原支持边界。
steps.route: 对流映射的 Jacobian 和支持距离作短时间控制，Lemmas 6.1–6.2 处理流坐标与欧氏坐标之间的误差；联合正性和动理学表示得到随机意义下的支持包含与严格外扩。
